description.en: Caytonia reproductive-axis reconstruction only. Leaf genus Sagenopteris and pollen-organ Caytonanthus association is supported by cooccurrence/cuticle evidence but whole-plant organic connections/habit unresolved; no attached leaves or whole-plant claim. Primary official compressed fossils and historic drawings constrain two ranks and recurvature; thickness/pose/palette,12 cupules and nominal5cm axis are artistic. Cupule is not an angiosperm fruit. Visible lip does not assert exact anatomical seed count.
